rows.text: The Clockie before your eyes pants and breathes heavily. The angle of their thin, folded legs against the circular clock face shows half-past two, as the heavy hour hand sways back and forth within a quarter-hour interval.

Every other day it's "voluntary overtime" or "we're cutting the half-year performance bonus"... We're here daily from dawn until dusk and the meager Alfalfa credits they pay us aren't even enough for a slice of Clockie Pizza after I've paid my hotel fees!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: We all love Clockie, but just because we're passionate about it doesn't mean that we're okay with being exploited! Even Boss Stone knows you can't just be evil without a solid reason!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Dagnabbit... Aren't... Aren't cartoons supposed to bring people joy?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Then why is it that ever since I came to Dreamville, I've lost all my happiness?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Dreamville really is a beautiful and peaceful... Ah, who am I kidding!
rows.speaker: Clockie
